name: io.github.lifenplanner/koreawavenews
title: KOREA WAVE NEWS
description: K-pop concerts and idol culture in Korea, artist profiles, K-drama, food, beauty and travel guides.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search articles, travel Q&A and guides on KOREA WAVE NEWS (Korean culture, K-pop, drama, beauty, food, Korean language, fashion). Returns id, title and URL.

query.description: Search words in any supported language

lang.description: Language code. Default ko. If the content is not available in that language, results fall back to the languages that exist.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the full text of a search result by its id (or its koreawavenews.com URL).

id.description: Result id from search, or a koreawavenews.com URL

tools.name: get_latest_articles
tools.description: List the newest KOREA WAVE NEWS articles, optionally by section.

lang.description: Language code. Default ko. If the content is not available in that language, results fall back to the languages that exist.

section.description: Section name such as K-영화, K-POP (optional)

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get one news article (title, date, section, summary and body) by article id such as KW20261115020 or by URL.

tools.name: search_qa
tools.description: Search Q&A and travel guides about Korea (opening hours, admission, parking, K-ETA, transport, food, culture). Answers are from public sources; check the source before travelling.

lang.description: Language code. Default ko. If the content is not available in that language, results fall back to the languages that exist.

kind.description: qa = place Q&A, guide = travel guide, any = both (default)

tools.name: search_kpop_guide
tools.description: Answers about K-pop in Korea: concert venues (Gocheok Sky Dome, KSPO DOME, Inspire Arena), ticketing and queues, ID checks, lightsticks, merch, fan culture, idol positions, fancams, music shows, scalping law, trips to Korea for concerts, trot, K-musicals and other live shows. Returns matching Q&A pairs with page URLs.

query.description: Question or keywords, e.g. "고척스카이돔 시야", "how to buy concert tickets in Korea"

tools.name: get_artist
tools.description: Get a K-pop group or singer profile Q&A from KOREA WAVE NEWS (debut, agency, members, fandom name, well-known songs) by name in Korean or English, e.g. BTS, 방탄소년단, aespa, IU.

tools.name: search_korea_guide
tools.description: Search Q&A guides on K-drama and filming locations, Korean food, K-beauty, Seoul fashion, Korean expressions, Korea travel tips and tourist places. Returns matching Q&A pairs with page URLs.

category.description: drama, food, beauty, fashion, korean, travel (practical tips), places (tourist spots), or any (default)

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List KOREA WAVE NEWS guide pages with URLs for a category (kpop, artist, drama, food, beauty, fashion, korean, travel = practical tips, places = tourist spots), to browse what is covered.

category.description: Category (travel = practical tips, places = tourist spots)
